title: Inter-dimensional World
summary: The Inter-dimensional World is a limbo-like world between the human dimension and the Spirit World.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
While the Huntik team explored Tír na nÓg, the full moon shed a ray of light which triggered a vortex that absorbed Lok Lambert and Cherit, leading them to the inter-dimensional world. 

There, Lok was able to talk with his father Eathon Lambert, who was trapped in the Spirit World. He was also able to contact the spirit of Lord Casterwill, which allowed him to bond with Pendragon. The only known way to exit this world was with the help of Umbra, the legendary Titan of dimensions. [Back Home]
